traditions.KJV: because of the evil of your doings .

13.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , [ and ] rock of the plain , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִ ךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָ עֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַ מִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς σὲ τὸν κατοικοῦντα τὴν κοιλάδα Σὸρ τὴν πεδινήν ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego ad te , habitatrícem vallis sólidæ atque campéstris , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , [ and ] rock of the plain , saith the LORD ;

13.english_reference: which say , Who shall come down against us ?

traditions.WLC: הָ אֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: τοὺς λέγοντας Τίς πτοήσει ἡμᾶς ;
traditions.KJV: which say , Who shall come down against us ?

13.english_reference: or who shall enter into our habitations ?

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּ מְעוֹנוֹתֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἢ τίς εἰσελεύσεται πρὸς τὸ κατοικητήριον ;
traditions.KJV: or who shall enter into our habitations ?

14.english_reference: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ פָקַדְתִּ֧י עֲלֵי כֶ֛ם כִּ פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵי כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Et visitábo super vos iuxta fructum studiórum vestrórum , dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the LORD :

14.english_reference: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof

traditions.WLC: וְ הִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּ יַעְרָ֔ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνάψω πῦρ ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: et succéndam ignem in saltu eius ,
traditions.KJV: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof ,

14.english_reference: and it shall devour all things round about it

traditions.WLC: וְ אָכְלָ֖ה כָּל סְבִיבֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδεται πάντα τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: et devorábit ómnia in circúitu eius .
traditions.KJV: and it shall devour all things round about it .
